edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by the Context._msgSender helper.
_msgSender result is stored into the owner state variable during Ownable setup.
block.timestamp is written into _holderFirstBuyTimestamp to drive early sell tax, a timestamp dependency.
tx.origin is used as the key for the per-block transfer delay timestamp mapping, an origin/timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router, a timestamp dependency.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard flag around swapBack.
_transfer invokes swapBack which performs external ETH transfers while swap state changes occur.
swapBack performs a low-level call sending ETH to devWallet, an external interaction enabling reentrancy.
swapBack performs a low-level call sending all remaining ETH to marketingWallet, a reentrancy-exposed external call.
devWallet state variable supplies the destination of the ETH-sending external call.
marketingWallet state variable supplies the destination of the ETH-sending external call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapTokensForEth reaches out to the Uniswap router via swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to seed the liquidity pool.
addLiquidity forwards ETH into the router addLiquidityETH external call.
Send executes a loop of transferFrom calls over recipients.
msg.sender provides the approval and source for the transferFrom calls inside Send.
enableTrading is guarded by onlyOwner checking _owner against _msgSender.
Send is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier tied to _owner.
ManageBot is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting blacklist control to the owner.
excludeFromFees is guarded by onlyOwner controlling fee exemptions.
_transfer computes fees using sellTotalFees with multiplication and division arithmetic.
_transfer computes fees using buyTotalFees with multiplication and division arithmetic.
automatedMarketMakerPairs values determine buy/sell branching and fee application in _transfer.
_blacklist entries gate the transfer require check in _transfer.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount controls whether max transaction and wallet limits apply.
_isExcludedFromFees controls whether fees are taken on a transfer.
